about: What each guide video says, one beat per step plus an opening. `say` is what the voice reads (numbers and short forms spelled the way they should sound); `sub` is the caption, as the screen prints it. tts.py speaks each line on its own; record.mjs holds each beat on screen while its lines are read.

card.title: Invoice a customer and get paid
card.purpose: Bill a customer for work, then record the money when it arrives, so the receivable clears itself.
steps: List open invoices and customer balances
Forecast the next thirteen weeks of cash

lines.say: Invoice a customer, and get paid.
lines.sub: Invoice a customer and get paid.

lines.say: Bill a customer for the work, then record the money when it arrives, and the receivable clears itself.
lines.sub: Bill a customer for the work, then record the money when it arrives, and the receivable clears itself.

lines.say: Step one. Create the invoice.
lines.sub: Step 1 · Create the invoice.

lines.say: Add a line for each item, then press Save draft. A draft posts nothing.
lines.sub: Add a line for each item, then press Save draft. A draft posts nothing.

lines.say: Step two. Send it to the ledger.
lines.sub: Step 2 · Send it to the ledger.

lines.say: Press Issue, on the draft's row. The invoice gets its number, and posts.
lines.sub: Press Issue on the draft's row. The invoice gets its number and posts.

lines.say: Step three. Give the customer a copy.
lines.sub: Step 3 · Give the customer a copy.

lines.say: Download P D F prints the issued invoice. A draft prints marked, draft.
lines.sub: Download PDF prints the issued invoice. A draft prints marked DRAFT.

lines.say: Step four. Record the money received.
lines.sub: Step 4 · Record the money received.

lines.say: Receive payment, and apply it to one or more of the customer's open invoices.
lines.sub: Receive payment, and apply it to one or more of the customer's open invoices.

lines.say: Step five. Check what is still outstanding.
lines.sub: Step 5 · Check what is still outstanding.

lines.say: Accounts Receivable Aging shows what each customer owes, by how overdue it is.
lines.sub: Accounts Receivable Aging shows what each customer owes, by how overdue it is.

lines.say: Step six. List open invoices, and customer balances.
lines.sub: Step 6 · List open invoices and customer balances.

lines.say: Both reports end on the aging total, and say whether it agrees with receivables.
lines.sub: Both reports end on the A/R Aging total, and say whether it agrees with receivables.

lines.say: Step seven. Forecast the next thirteen weeks of cash.
lines.sub: Step 7 · Forecast the next 13 weeks of cash.

lines.say: Today's cash, plus what customers owe, less what you owe suppliers, week by week.
lines.sub: Today's cash, plus what customers owe, less what you owe suppliers, week by week.

card.title: Give a customer an estimate and turn it into an invoice
card.purpose: Promise a price before the sale, then turn it into an invoice when the customer says yes.
steps: Turn a yes into an invoice
If the sale falls through after all

lines.say: Give a customer an estimate, and turn it into an invoice.
lines.sub: Give a customer an estimate and turn it into an invoice.

lines.say: Promise a price before the sale, then invoice it when the customer says yes.
lines.sub: Promise a price before the sale, then invoice it when the customer says yes.

lines.say: Step one. Write the estimate.
lines.sub: Step 1 · Write the estimate.

lines.say: Its lines work as on an invoice. Saving gives it a number, and posts nothing.
lines.sub: Its lines work as on an invoice. Saving gives it a number and posts nothing.

lines.say: Step two. Give the customer a copy.
lines.sub: Step 2 · Give the customer a copy.

lines.say: It prints as a quotation, with a valid-until date, and nothing owed.
lines.sub: It prints as a quotation, with Valid until and nothing owed.

lines.say: Step three. Record a no.
lines.sub: Step 3 · Record a no.

lines.say: Mark it declined. Reopen brings it back, if the customer changes their mind.
lines.sub: Mark declined. Reopen brings it back if the customer changes their mind.

lines.say: Step four. Turn a yes into an invoice.
lines.sub: Step 4 · Turn a yes into an invoice.

lines.say: This opens a new invoice, with the customer and the lines already filled in.
lines.sub: This opens New invoice, with the customer and the lines already filled in.

lines.say: Step five. Create the draft.
lines.sub: Step 5 · Create the draft.

lines.say: Press Save draft. The estimate now reads converted, and locks. The draft posts nothing yet.
lines.sub: Press Save draft. The estimate now reads Converted and locks. The draft posts nothing yet.

lines.say: Step six. Issue the invoice.
lines.sub: Step 6 · Issue the invoice.

lines.say: It posts like any other invoice. The estimate itself never posts.
lines.sub: It posts like any other invoice. The estimate itself never posts.

lines.say: Step seven. If the sale falls through, after all.
lines.sub: Step 7 · If the sale falls through after all.

lines.say: Voiding that invoice opens the estimate again, to reuse it, or to decline it.
lines.sub: Voiding that invoice opens the estimate again, to reuse or decline.

card.title: Bring bank lines in
card.purpose: Load a statement or a bank feed, and make sure what comes in adds up.
steps: Check that the statement adds up
Import a statement that does not add up

lines.say: Bring bank lines in.
lines.sub: Bring bank lines in.

lines.say: Load a statement, or a bank feed, and make sure what comes in adds up.
lines.sub: Load a statement or a bank feed, and make sure what comes in adds up.

lines.say: Step one. Bring in the statement.
lines.sub: Step 1 · Bring in the statement.

lines.say: Import statement takes a P D F, C S V, O F X, Q F X, Q B O, or Q I F file. A line that is already in, is skipped.
lines.sub: Import statement takes a PDF, CSV, OFX, QFX, QBO or QIF file. A line already in is skipped.

lines.say: Step two. Check that the statement adds up.
lines.sub: Step 2 · Check that the statement adds up.

lines.say: The opening balance, plus the lines, must reach the closing balance, to the cent, before you import.
lines.sub: The opening balance plus the lines must reach the closing balance, to the cent, before you import.

lines.say: Step three. Make a statement add up.
lines.sub: Step 3 · Make a statement add up.

lines.say: Tick, Not a transaction, beside a line that was misread, or type a balance the file does not print.
lines.sub: Tick Not a transaction beside a line that was misread, or type a balance the file does not print.

lines.say: Step four. Import a statement that does not add up.
lines.sub: Step 4 · Import a statement that does not add up.

lines.say: Only an administrator can, with Import anyway, and a reason that is kept in the audit log.
lines.sub: Only an administrator can, with Import anyway and a reason that is kept in the audit log.

lines.say: Step five. Take back a bank feed sync.
lines.sub: Step 5 · Take back a bank-feed sync.

lines.say: Under Bank feed syncs, Undo takes back the newest sync that brought lines in, with a reason.
lines.sub: Under Bank feed syncs, Undo takes back the newest sync that brought lines in, with a reason.

lines.say: Step six. Disconnect a bank feed.
lines.sub: Step 6 · Disconnect a bank feed.

lines.say: This removes the connection at Plaid. The lines already brought in, stay.
lines.sub: This removes the connection at Plaid. The lines already brought in stay.

card.title: Reconcile an account to a statement
card.purpose: Agree a bank account with one statement, line by line, until nothing is left to explain.
steps: See how far each account is reconciled
Set aside a misread statement line
Add the lines the books are missing
Add a line held back from the others

lines.say: Reconcile an account to a statement.
lines.sub: Reconcile an account to a statement.

lines.say: Agree a bank account with one statement, line by line, until nothing is left to explain.
lines.sub: Agree a bank account with one statement, line by line, until nothing is left to explain.

lines.say: Step one. See how far each account is reconciled.
lines.sub: Step 1 · See how far each account is reconciled.

lines.say: Each account shows the last statement it agreed with, colored by its age: green, amber, or red.
lines.sub: Each account shows the last statement it agreed with, colored by its age: green, amber or red.

lines.say: Step two. Reconcile to a statement balance.
lines.sub: Step 2 · Reconcile to a statement balance.

lines.say: Start a new reconciliation. Complete needs a difference of zero, or an adjustment somebody signs for.
lines.sub: Start a New reconciliation. Complete needs a difference of zero, or an adjustment somebody signs for.

lines.say: Step three. Read the difference.
lines.sub: Step 3 · Read the difference.

lines.say: It is shown in its parts. When one line is the size of what is left, it is named. Check that one first.
lines.sub: It is shown in its parts. When one line is the size of what is left, it is named: check that one first.

lines.say: Step four. Set aside a misread statement line.
lines.sub: Step 4 · Set aside a misread statement line.

lines.say: Not a transaction leaves it out of the difference. Restore brings it back.
lines.sub: Not a transaction leaves it out of the difference. Restore brings it back.

lines.say: Step five. Add the lines the books are missing.
lines.sub: Step 5 · Add the lines the books are missing.

lines.say: Choose each line's account, then add them. Each one posts an entry, already ticked.
lines.sub: Choose each line's account, then add them. Each one posts an entry, already ticked.

lines.say: Step six. Add a line held back from the others.
lines.sub: Step 6 · Add a line held back from the others.

lines.say: A line that looks extra, or already booked, waits for you. Add anyway posts that one alone.
lines.sub: A line that looks extra, or already booked, waits for you. Add anyway posts that one alone.

lines.say: Step seven. Start a reconciliation again.
lines.sub: Step 7 · Start a reconciliation again.

lines.say: Discard removes the reconciliation, and its ticks. The statement file and the entries stay.
lines.sub: Discard removes the reconciliation and its ticks. The statement file and the entries stay.

lines.say: Step eight. View the statement file.
lines.sub: Step 8 · View the statement file.

lines.say: The statement, just as the bank gave it, shown inside One Book.
lines.sub: The statement, just as the bank gave it, shown inside OneBook.

lines.say: Step nine. Attach the statement.
lines.sub: Step 9 · Attach the statement.

lines.say: An older reconciliation with no file takes one here, if it matches its figures.
lines.sub: An older reconciliation with no file takes one here, if it matches its figures.
